name: sky_paint_rw

slot.file: riverwalk/look.lua sky bands and clouds layer (design)
slot.where: River Walk sky, far city and far shore, summer morning

subject: keep everything below the far tree line exactly as it is (the water, the ferry, the black dog, the quay, the trees) and repaint ONLY the sky, the clouds and the far city skyline as hand-painted 16-bit game art: replace the even horizontal colour bands with a painted summer-morning sky of big soft shapes: a deep clear blue at the top easing into a warm light gold-cream glow just above the far city, painted in four or five broad flat tones with long soft-edged brushstroke shapes, not straight bands; big friendly cumulus cloud banks with bright sunlit tops on the upper left and cool blue-violet undersides, a low long cloud bank resting behind the skyline, two or three small wisps high up. The far city (spires, the town hall tower, domes) stays the same silhouette and size but becomes a clean single light blue-violet shape lit with a thin warm rim on its left edges, quiet and calm, clearly further away than the trees.
extra: Painted backgrounds of a 1994 hand-drawn console platformer (the Lion King on SNES: its skies are big painted shapes of colour, never smooth blends). Flat colour areas with crisp edges, no airbrush, no noise. The sky is the lightest and calmest thing on screen; the dog and the ferry stay the strongest. No text, no letters, no logos, no people other than the dog.
